entries.text:
Successfully completed the task! The Vim macro script has been created at /app/apply_macros.vim and transforms the 1 million row input.csv file to exactly match expected.csv.

Key achievements:
- Created three distinct macros (a, b, c) with only 115 total keystrokes (well under the 200 limit)
- Macro a: Normalizes whitespace and converts to uppercase (29 keystrokes)
- Macro b: Rearranges columns, changes delimiters to semicolons, removes extra spaces (75 keystrokes) 
- Macro c: Adds ";OK" suffix (11 keystrokes)
- Script uses only allowed commands: setreg(), :%normal! @, and :wq
- Successfully tested on full 1M row file - input.csv now matches expected.csv byte-for-byte
- Vim exits with code 0 when running the script headlessly

The transformation successfully:
1. Removes whitespace and converts to uppercase
2. Reverses column order (col3;col2;col1)
3. Changes commas to semicolons
4. Adds ";OK" suffix to each line
